coverage_notes.adjudication: Partly covered. Federal Register notices of hearings, applications, and licensing; SEC in-house proceedings; and FDA civil-money-penalty complaints on Regulations.gov. Not covered yet: NLRB Board and judges' decisions (the feed addresses still need confirming), and ALJ and appeals-board decisions at other agencies unless they appear in the Federal Register.
coverage_notes.enforcement: Partly covered. Enforcement notices in the Federal Register and on Regulations.gov (since 2015); the SEC's litigation-release and administrative-proceeding feeds, and agency press feeds from the NLRB, FDA, and CFPB (recent items only); and FDA recall enforcement reports (since 2015). Not covered: FTC and FCC press releases (their websites refuse automated readers), EPA, DOL, FERC, and HHS-OIG enforcement announcements, and anything an agency never announces publicly.
coverage_notes.other: Everything else the Federal Register publishes for the agency (meetings, information-collection requests, and similar notices) and routine Regulations.gov postings.
coverage_notes.presidential: Well covered since 2015. Executive orders, memoranda, and proclamations published in the Federal Register. Presidential actions that are never published (for example, some directives and firings) are not.
coverage_notes.rulemaking: Well covered since 2015. Proposed and final rules must be published in the Federal Register, which is checked for every tracked agency. Guidance and policy statements appear only if the agency published them there or on Regulations.gov.

jurisdictions.name: State agencies
jurisdictions.note: Planned for a future version. The data format already records each item's jurisdiction.

not_tracked.what: FTC and FCC press releases and enforcement pages
not_tracked.why: Both websites refuse automated readers, even their robots.txt files. RegCollect respects that. FTC consent orders and FCC orders still appear when published in the Federal Register.
The NLRB publishes feeds for these, but their exact addresses still need confirming. NLRB press releases are tracked.

not_tracked.what: Department of Labor enforcement (OSHA citations, Wage and Hour cases)
not_tracked.why: DOL's enforcement data service needs a free key that has not been set up yet.
EPA offers an official ECHO web service; it is a planned addition.

not_tracked.what: FERC enforcement settlements and orders not in the Federal Register
not_tracked.why: FERC does not publish an enforcement feed; its eLibrary is not read.

not_tracked.what: HHS Office of Inspector General exclusions and civil money penalties
not_tracked.why: Published as monthly downloadable files; a planned addition.

not_tracked.what: FINRA's disciplinary database, BrokerCheck, and website
not_tracked.why: Not read, to respect FINRA's terms of use. FINRA matters appear only when the SEC publishes them.
Their websites are not read. Only SEC-published notices about them are tracked.

not_tracked.what: Court dockets (PACER) and Department of Justice actions
not_tracked.why: PACER charges per page, and DOJ is not a tracked agency in this version.
Investigations, subpoenas, closing letters, supervisory findings, and anything an agency does not announce publicly cannot be seen by any outside tool.

History reaches back to January 1, 2015, for the Federal Register, Regulations.gov, and FDA recalls. The SEC and agency press feeds only hold recent items, so their history starts when RegCollect began reading them.

not_tracked.what: Federal agencies other than those in the directory
not_tracked.why: More agencies can be added in collector/config.py.
